name: Ore ga Honmono no Do S ni Naru made no Hentai BBA to no Kindan Ishitsu Seiai ~Hikareau S to M! Hentai no Kaikou~
original_name: 俺が本物のドSになるまでの変態BBAとの禁断異質性愛 ～惹かれ合うSとM! 変態の邂逅～
source:
Itouda Naito, a cram school teacherr, was mischievously appealing to his students in the hope that some of them would be attracted to his appeal as a sadist. 

One day, he was questioned by the grandmother of one of his students, Kougo Chiyomi.

She said, “I heard that you have been going around the school saying that you are a sadist. What is the truth behind that?"

"Why did you make such a disgusting comment in such an environment?"

Chiyomi then offered him a deal.

"Will you be my trainer?" She said.

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_030/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
补习班教师Itouda Naito时常带着恶作剧般的心态，在学生面前展露抖S的一面，希望有人会被自己吸引。

某天，一名学生的祖母Kougo Chiyomi找他问话。

“听说你到处跟学生说，自己是个抖S。到底是怎么回事？”

“为什么要在那种场合，说出这么令人反感的话？”

随后，Chiyomi向他提出了一笔交易。

“你愿意做我的调教师吗？”
